proofs.text: Record `PROOF-1` as failing and run the auto-approval; verify nothing is written

rule_text: CI never auto-approves a rule whose record carries a failing proof

tests.body:
def test_a_failing_record_is_not_auto_approved(self):
        made = Project()
        try:
            made.proofs({'PROOF-1': 'fail', 'PROOF-2': 'pass'})
            made.record({'PROOF-1': 'fail', 'PROOF-2': 'pass'})
            assert approve_module.auto_approve(made.root) == []
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_failing_record_is_not_auto_approved
